attribution.editorial_statement: Bangla explanation and examples adapted and written for Ovidhan.

bangla_explanation.text: অহেতুক নিয়ম ও কাগজে কাজ আটকে থাকা।

definition.oewn_definition: any organization in which action is obstructed by insistence on unnecessary procedures and red tape
definition.text: any organization in which action is obstructed by insistence on unnecessary procedures and red tape

examples.en: Bureaucracy delayed the repair of the bridge.

bangla_explanation.text: নির্বাচিত প্রতিনিধি নয়, নিয়োগ পাওয়া দপ্তর যে শাসন চালায়।

definition.oewn_definition: a government that is administered primarily by bureaus that are staffed with nonelective officials
definition.text: a government that is administered primarily by bureaus that are staffed with nonelective officials

examples.bn: পাঠ্যবই আমলাতান্ত্রিক শাসনকে নির্বাচিত সরকারের সঙ্গে তুলনা করল।
examples.en: The textbook compared bureaucracy with elected government.
